item.title: Glimpses of sunshine and warmer temperatures ahead
item.description: This week will bring glimpses of sunshine and slightly warmer temperatures, with highs in the upper 40s and lower 50s, before a low-pressure system brings clouds, colder air, and a chance for light showers and drizzle on Sunday.
